SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-23-2021 - JUDGMENT. PLAINTIFF KAMEL BOUZIDI DBA CAFE MED IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT RYAN HARPER, DBA AZUL WORKS HOLDING INC IS PRESENT. RYAN HARPER IS THE PROJECT MANAGER FOR AZUL WORKS HODLING INC. COURT DETERMINES THAT RYAN HARPER, SHOULD NOT BE A NAMED DEFENDANT AND IS TO BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. THE CORRECT NAMED PARTY IS AZUL WORKS HOLDING INC. CASE IS UPDATED ADDING AZUL WORKS HOLDING INC AS THE NAMED DEFENDANT. RYAN HARPER, PROJECT MANAGER FOR AZUL WORKS HOLDING INC IS AUTHORIZED TO APPEAR ON BEHALF OF AZUL WORKS HOLDING INC. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS ARE REVIEWED AND RETURNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BOUZIDI, KAMEL DBA CAFE MED RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT AZUL WORKS HOLDINGS INC. $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,090.00, COURT DISMISSES WITH PREJUDICE DEFENDANT RYAN HARPER. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
